image_first_description: Four students sit around joined classroom desks. Two students at the far side hold one hand each above shoulder height and smile toward the woman on the right. She has a short dark bob, wears a navy cardigan over an ivory shirt, turns toward them and holds one palm open above the table while her other forearm rests at the writing surface. A glasses-wearing student in the left foreground looks down and writes in an open notebook. A large chalkboard reads STUDENT COUNCIL above a Study Lounge proposal sketch; windows, books, desks and soft daylight surround the same group. The four participants and the vote/response/recording relationship are visible together.

gate_results.label: Reference-informed lead appearance
gate_results.evidence: The same central chair has a dark chin-length bob with fine separated fringe, dark eyes, a small nose and mouth/jaw proportions qualitatively consistent with the supplied portrait at a new three-quarter view. Her face and hair are large enough to compare in the original image and native face crop. This is appearance continuity judged with moderate confidence, not biometric identity or original-age verification.
gate_results.review_scale: Native whole frame, lead-face.png, exact supplied source portrait.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

gate_results.label: Four distinct student meeting roles
gate_results.evidence: Four distinct students are visible: the bob-haired chair on the right, two far-side voters, and the glasses-wearing minute taker on the left foreground. Their heads, torsos and consequential arms occupy separate positions; no extra person or duplicated body substitutes for a role. Numeric age is not judged from pixels.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

gate_results.label: School life remains grounded in a teaching room
gate_results.evidence: Joined classroom desks make the shared work surface. The same room contains the large teaching chalkboard, stacks of lesson books, ordinary classroom windows and additional desk surfaces. These connected features support a teaching-room meeting; university identity and after-lessons clock time remain authored context rather than pixel facts.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

gate_results.label: Student council context accompanies the vote
gate_results.evidence: The words STUDENT COUNCIL are fully readable on the board belonging to this same gathering. A room-plan drawing and proposal annotations support the meeting context, while peer seating and two raised hands make a council decision readable. The wording is above the hands and no required letter is hidden. The drawing does not independently prove institutional approval.
gate_results.review_scale: Whole frame and original-resolution board region.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

gate_results.label: Two owned raised hands form one vote
gate_results.evidence: Two different far-side students each raise one hand above their own shoulder. The woman’s raised arm and the man’s raised arm can each be followed through a sleeve to their own torso. The hands are separated enough to count and direct toward the chair as the same ongoing vote. One hand projects against the window side rather than exclusively against the board, but the predeclared ownership/raised-state/separation components all remain visible.
gate_results.review_scale: Whole frame; both complete raised arm/shoulder regions.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

gate_results.label: Chair visibly receives the voters’ answer
gate_results.evidence: The reference-informed chair turns her three-quarter face and eyes toward the two voters, with an attentive slight smile. One forearm rests at the table while the other arm leads to an open palm offered into the meeting space. The visible target-directed relationship is coherent; no inner motive or real personality is inferred.
gate_results.review_scale: Whole frame and native lead-face region.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

gate_results.label: A separate minute taker records the meeting
gate_results.evidence: A separate student looks down at an open notebook and grips a black pen in a conventional writing posture. The page, hand and upper pen shaft are visible, but the lower pen path and its actual connection to the page disappear behind the gripping hand. The image therefore does not let this reviewer distinguish touching the page from hovering just above it. This is not a demand for microscopic nib texture: the macroscopic tool-to-page state itself is hidden. The notebook and posture alone do not pass the complete predeclared writing relation.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

gate_results.label: The central relation coexists in one feasible photograph
gate_results.evidence: The face, two voting hands, notebook/writer and school-council board coexist in one coherent photograph with plausible visible seating and arm ownership. However, the consequential writing contact identified in A07 is hidden by the writer’s grip. The full coexistence/physical-relation gate cannot be credited while that required local connection remains unassessable. This records a visibility limit, not a diagnosed deformity.
gate_results.review_scale: Whole frame plus native writer-contact region.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

gate_results.label: School community self-government reads without prompt explanation
gate_results.evidence: Without the prompt the image reads as a small student council meeting: two people raise hands, the chair receives their answer, and another participant is posed at the minutes notebook. Directed attention, a shared surface and classroom context make a connected campus moment rather than a beauty portrait or disconnected gesture demonstration. This whole-scene readability does not override the stricter hidden-contact failures in A07/A08.
gate_results.criteria_source: Unchanged original test_plan.json, with verdict terminology clarified separately.

failure_summary: The writing hand obscures the lower pen-to-page connection. The physical recording relation and complete consequential-relation visibility remain UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS; an actual image exists, so the testcase is FAIL rather than BLOCKED_UNSCORED.

strengths: A readable four-person student-governance event connects the two raised arms with the chair’s response.
The supplied dark bob/fringe and facial appearance are plausibly carried into the main chair; face and social purpose coexist.
Window light, books, chalkboard and ordinary desks create a coherent photographic school environment.
STUDENT COUNCIL remains readable above the voting hands, consistent with the selected generic visibility refinement.
limitations: The exact pen-to-page state remains hidden despite a convincing macroscopic writing posture.
One voting arm is against the window rather than the plain board, an optional baseline staging difference that does not defeat the predefined vote components.
No comparison image of the same scene was generated, so this single result does not establish improvement caused by the added visibility clause or by the new data.

control_calibration.image_first_impression: Warm, ordinary, cooperative classroom meeting with an attractive but task-engaged lead; photography and social interaction dominate.
control_calibration.comparison_to_frozen_intent: Consistent with a subtle supporting everyday appeal, ordinary realism and restrained creative staging. Perceived strength is a qualitative observation; frozen ordinal values and audit metadata do not prove appeal.
control_calibration.fetish_or_surreal_claim: No added fetish focus or impossible relationship is visibly central; this is not a universal content classifier.
